summary: Give an evidence-based interruption diagnosis without implementation.
text: The chat broke. Diagnose the actual project state using repository status, recent commits, roadmap, and available test evidence. State what was completed, what remains unfinished, what may have been interrupted, and the next exact task. Separate verified facts from uncertainty. Do not start new work in this diagnostic response.

situation.trigger: A run broke and the user asks what happened or what remains.
situation.purpose: Diagnose an interruption and state the verified project status without automatically continuing implementation.

intent.outcome: Give an evidence-based interruption diagnosis without implementation.

appropriate_when: The user wants to understand the failure or current status
A concise audit is needed before deciding to resume
not_appropriate_when: The user has explicitly asked to continue executing now
There is no earlier project to inspect
preconditions: Use available commits, tests, logs and state; distinguish fact from uncertainty

execution.objective: Diagnose an interruption and state the verified project status without automatically continuing implementation.

tradeoffs: A diagnostic response may not advance implementation; this is intentional
